# Integrate data

## Merge
```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(Agca_snLLC) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Brown_scLLC) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Kim_scB16F10) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Pryce_scC26) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Pryce_scKPP) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(Zhang_snKIC) <- "RNA"

Agca_snLLC$experiment <- "Agca_snLLC"
Brown_scLLC$experiment <- "Brown_scLLC"
Kim_scB16F10$experiment <- "Kim_scB16F10"
Pryce_scC26$experiment <- "Pryce_scC26"
Pryce_scKPP$experiment <- "Pryce_scKPP"
Zhang_snKIC$experiment <- "Zhang_snKIC"

sc_combined <- merge(Agca_snLLC, y = list(Brown_scLLC, Kim_scB16F10, Pryce_scC26, Pryce_scKPP, Zhang_snKIC), add.cell.ids = c("Agca_snLLC", "Brown_scLLC", "Kim_scB16F10", "Pryce_scC26", "Pryce_scKPP", "Zhang_snKIC"))

rm(Agca_snLLC, Brown_scLLC, Kim_scB16F10, Pryce_scC26, Pryce_scKPP, Zhang_snKIC)
```


## Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined <- NormalizeData(sc_combined) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(sc_combined, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined <- sc_combined %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:40) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

umap.method = 'umap-learn'
metric = 'correlation'

sc_combined <- RunUMAP(sc_combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:40)
```


## Visualize data sets prior to Harmony Integration

```{r}
DimPlot(sc_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, raster = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Run harmony

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined <- RunHarmony(sc_combined, group.by.vars = "experiment")

sc_combined <- FindNeighbors(sc_combined,reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

sc_combined <- RunUMAP(sc_combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
```


## Visualize data integration after harmony

```{r}
DimPlot(sc_combined, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "HARMONY1", y = "HARMONY2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

```{r}
DimPlot(sc_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, raster = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```



# Annotate clusters 

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(sc_combined) <- "RNA"

Idents(sc_combined) <- sc_combined$seurat_clusters
sc_combined <- JoinLayers(sc_combined, what = "all")

DEGs_sc_combined <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = sc_combined, group.by = "seurat_clusters", 
  test.use = "LR", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
```


## Specify clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined_cluster_ids <- levels(sc_combined$seurat_clusters)

sc_combined_cluster_labels <- c("Endothelial cells", "FAPs", "FAPs", "Myonuclei", "B/T/NK cells", "B/T/NK cells", "Myonuclei", "Myonuclei", "Myonuclei", "Neutrophils", "Endothelial cells", "vSMCs/pericytes", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Satellite cells", "FAPs", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Epithelial cells", "FAPs", "Endothelial cells", "Endothelial cells", "Neutrophils", "vSMCs/pericytes", "Tenocytes", "Endothelial cells", "Erythrocytes", "Neutrophils", "Myonuclei", "Platelets", "Neural/glial/Schwann cells", "FAPs", "Myonuclei", "Myoblasts", "Endothelial cells", "Endothelial cells", "Myonuclei", "FAPs", "Erythrocytes", "vSMCs/pericytes", "Endothelial cells", "Adipocytes", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Neural/glial/Schwann cells")

sc_combined_clusters <- sc_combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters

sc_combined$seurat_clusters <- sc_combined_cluster_labels[sc_combined$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(sc_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Satellite cells", "Myoblasts", "Myonuclei", "Endothelial cells", "vSMCs/pericytes", "FAPs", "Tenocytes", "Adipocytes", "Platelets", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B/T/NK cells", "Neural/glial/Schwann cells", "Erythrocytes", "Epithelial cells"))
```


## Cluster 8 is a mixed cluster

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.9"

cluster8 <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "8")

cluster8 <- NormalizeData(cluster8)
cluster8 <- FindVariableFeatures(cluster8, nfeatures = 2000)
cluster8 <- ScaleData(cluster8)
cluster8 <- RunPCA(cluster8, npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(cluster8, ndims = 50)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
cluster8 <- FindNeighbors(cluster8,reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:41) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

cluster8 <- RunUMAP(cluster8, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:41)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(cluster8) <- "RNA"

Idents(cluster8) <- cluster8$seurat_clusters
cluster8 <- JoinLayers(cluster8, what = "all")

DEGs_cluster8 <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = cluster8, group.by = "seurat_clusters", 
  test.use = "LR", only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

write.csv(DEGs_cluster8, file = "DEGs_cluster8.csv")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(cluster8) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster8_cluster_labels <- c("FAPs", "FAPs", "FAPs", "Erythrocytes", "Adipocytes", "Myonuclei", "Myonuclei", "Erythrocytes", "Myonuclei", "FAPs", "FAPs", "Tenocytes", "Endothelial cells")

cluster8_clusters <- cluster8@meta.data$seurat_clusters

cluster8$seurat_clusters <- cluster8_cluster_labels[cluster8$seurat_clusters]
```

### Write new cluster labels back into sc_combined

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$seurat_clusters[Cells(cluster8)] <- cluster8$seurat_clusters

rm(cluster8, DEGs_cluster8, cluster8_cluster_labels, cluster8_clusters)
```

# Visualize

## UMAP by experiment

```{r}
DimPlot(sc_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## UMAP plot highlighting certain experiments

```{r}
DimPlot(
  sc_combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "experiment",
  cells.highlight = list("#experiment_name#" = WhichCells(sc_combined, expression = experiment == "#experiment_name#")),
  sizes.highlight = 1,
  pt.size = 1,
  cols.highlight = "#COLOUR_HEX_CODE"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## DotPlot to show differentially expressed genes between clusters

```{r}
DefaultAssay(sc_combined) <- "RNA"
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = sc_combined, features = c(
  "Pax7", "Myf5", # MuSCs
  "Myod1", "Myog", # Myoblast
  "Acta1", # Myonuclei 
    "Myh7", ## TI 
    "Myh2", ## TIIa 
    "Myh4", ## TIIb 
    "Myh1", ## TIIx
  "Cdh5", "Pecam1", # Endothelial cells 
    "Fmo1", "Fmo2", ## capillary venous
    "Apln", ## angiogenic
  "Myl9", "Pdgfrb", ## vSMCs/pericytes
  "Pdgfra", # FAPs
    "Cd34", "Dpp4", "Pi16", ## stem FAPs
    "Mme", "Mmp2", "Col3a1", ## pro-remodeling
    "Dcn", ## fibroblast
  "Tnmd", # Tenocytes
  "Mmrn1", "Ccl21a", ## platelet
    "Cpa3", "Tpsb2", ## mast cells
    "Fscn1", "Flt3", ## dendritic cells
    "Itgam", "Ccr2", "Fabp5", "Cx3cr1", "Ly6c1", "Ly6c2", ## monocytes
      "Cd68", "Cd74", "Cd83", ### macrophages
      "Ccl6", "Ccl9", #### pro-inflammatory macrophage
      "C1qa", #### anti-inflammatory macrophage
    "S100a8", "S100a9", ## neutrophils
    "Ms4a1", "Cd79a", # B cell
    "Il7r", "Cd4", "Cd8a", "Cd27",  # T cell
    "Nkg7", "Klra7", # NK cell
  "Ptn", "Cdh19", "Mpz", "S100b", ### Neural/glial/Schwann cells
  "Gypa", "Hba-a2", ### Erythrocytes
  "Krt15", "Epcam" ### Epithelial cells
  )) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, face = "italic")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```



# Clean up sc_combined seurat object

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$RNA_snn_res.0.1 <- NULL
sc_combined$scDblFinder.class <- NULL

sc_combined$orig.clusters.res.0.9 <- sc_combined$RNA_snn_res.0.9
sc_combined$RNA_snn_res.0.9 <- NULL

sc_combined@meta.data <- sc_combined@meta.data[, c(
  "experiment",
  "orig.ident",
  "seurat_clusters",
  "orig.clusters.res.0.9",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mito"
)]
```


# SUBCLUSTER ANALYSES!!!



# Satellite cells

## Subset satellite_cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"
all_genes <- rownames(sc_combined)

satellite_cells <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Satellite cells")
```


## Re-process cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
satellite_cells[["RNA"]]@layers <- satellite_cells[["RNA"]]@layers[c("counts", "data")]

satellite_cells <- NormalizeData(satellite_cells) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = VariableFeatures(satellite_cells)) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(satellite_cells, ndims = 50)
```


## Run harmony

### When we do this without running harmony, the cells cluster by experiment

```{r, include=FALSE}
satellite_cells <- RunHarmony(satellite_cells, group.by.vars = "experiment", theta = 4)

satellite_cells <- FindNeighbors(satellite_cells,reduction = "harmony",
                                dims = 1:31) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

satellite_cells <- RunUMAP(satellite_cells, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:31)
```


## Visualize data integration

```{r}
DimPlot(satellite_cells, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "harmony1", y = "harmony2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Join layers

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(satellite_cells) <- "RNA"

Idents(satellite_cells) <- satellite_cells$seurat_clusters
satellite_cells <- JoinLayers(satellite_cells, what = "all")
```


## Specify subclusters

### NOTE - I got these initially by visually comparing key markers between subclusters, and running FindAllMarkers to get list of genes different between subclusters.

```{r, include=FALSE}
satellite_cells_cluster_ids <- levels(satellite_cells$seurat_clusters)

satellite_cells_cluster_labels <- c("Quiescent SCs", "Cachectic SCs", "Activated SCs", "Quiescent SCs", "Activated SCs", "Pro-angiogenic SCs", "Erythrocytes")

satellite_cells_clusters <- satellite_cells@meta.data$seurat_clusters

satellite_cells$seurat_clusters <- satellite_cells_cluster_labels[satellite_cells$seurat_clusters]
```


## Order subclusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
satellite_cells$seurat_clusters <- factor(satellite_cells$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Quiescent SCs", "Activated SCs", "Cachectic SCs", "Pro-angiogenic SCs", "Erythrocytes"))
```

```{r}
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), plot.title = element_text(face = "italic")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Pax7")

VlnPlot_Myod1 <- VlnPlot(satellite_cells, features = "Myod1", pt.size = 0) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Myod1")
VlnPlot_Cebpb <- VlnPlot(satellite_cells, features = "Cebpb", pt.size = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), plot.title = element_text(face = "italic")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = "Cebpb")
VlnPlot_Socs3 <- VlnPlot(satellite_cells, features = "Socs3", pt.size = 0) +

VlnPlot_Fabp4 <- VlnPlot(satellite_cells, features = "Fabp4", pt.size = 0) +
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
FAPs <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "FAPs")

FAPs$subcluster <- NA
```


## Re-process cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
FAPs[["RNA"]]@layers <- FAPs[["RNA"]]@layers[c("counts", "data")]

FAPs <- NormalizeData(FAPs) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = VariableFeatures(FAPs)) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(FAPs, ndims = 50)
```


## Run harmony

```{r, include=FALSE}
FAPs <- RunHarmony(FAPs, group.by.vars = "experiment", theta = 4)

FAPs <- FindNeighbors(FAPs,reduction = "harmony",
                                dims = 1:43) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.9)

FAPs <- RunUMAP(FAPs, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:43)
```


## Visualize data integration

```{r}
DimPlot(FAPs, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "experiment", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "harmony1", y = "harmony2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Join layers

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(FAPs) <- "RNA"

Idents(FAPs) <- FAPs$seurat_clusters
FAPs <- JoinLayers(FAPs, what = "all")
```


## Specify subclusters

### NOTE - I got these initially by visually comparing key markers between subclusters, and running FindAllMarkers to get list of genes different between subclusters.

```{r, include=FALSE}
FAPs_cluster_ids <- levels(FAPs$seurat_clusters)

FAPs_cluster_labels <- c("Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Immuno FAPs", "Erythrocytes", "Pro-angiogenic FAPs", "Stem FAPs", "Pro-adipogenic FAPs", "Stem FAPs", "Pro-adipogenic FAPs", "Pro-adipogenic FAPs", "Stem FAPs", "Immuno FAPs", "Pro-adipogenic FAPs", "Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Activated FAPs", "Activated FAPs", "Epithelial cells", "Tenm2+ FAPs", "Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Tenm2+ FAPs", "Monocytes/macrophages", "Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Pro-angiogenic FAPs")

FAPs_clusters <- FAPs@meta.data$seurat_clusters

FAPs$seurat_clusters <- FAPs_cluster_labels[FAPs$seurat_clusters]
```

### NOTE - Erythrocyte cluster is a mix of erythrocytes, myonuclei and FAPs. Even though there are quite a few, I am going to remove this subcluster because I do not want to cluster AGAIN (worried about removing real biological features).


## Order subclusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
FAPs$seurat_clusters <- factor(FAPs$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Stem FAPs", "Activated FAPs", "Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Pro-angiogenic FAPs", "Pro-adipogenic FAPs", "Immuno FAPs", "Tenm2+ FAPs", "Monocytes/macrophages","Erythrocytes", "Epithelial cells"))
```


## Add Monocytes/macrophages back to  Monocytes/macrophages cluster and remove from FAPs

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(FAPs) <- "seurat_clusters"

monocytes_macrophages <- colnames(FAPs)[FAPs$seurat_clusters == "Monocytes/macrophages"]

sc_combined$seurat_clusters[monocytes_macrophages] <- "Monocytes/macrophages"

FAPs <- subset(FAPs, cells = setdiff(colnames(FAPs), monocytes_macrophages))

rm(monocytes_macrophages)
```

### NOTE - If there are any questions as to whether or not these are monocyte/macrophages, do a violin plot for Cd74. If there are questions about erythrocytes, do Hba-a2, and for epithelial cells do Krt15.

```{r}
FAPs_cluster_ids <- levels(FAPs$seurat_clusters)
Idents(FAPs) <- "seurat_clusters"

DotPlot(object = FAPs,features = c("Dpp4", "Pi16", "Postn", "Timp1", "Mme", "Cxcl14", "Cdh5", "Egfl7", "Gsn","Bgn", "Igfbp3", "Osmr", "Il6", "Ccl7", "Cebpb", "Tenm2", "Tnnc2", "Ptprc", "Krt15")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```


## Visualize subclusters

```{r}
DimPlot(FAPs, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Write new subcluster labels back into sc_combined

```{r, include=FALSE}

  as.character(FAPs$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
myonuclei_cells <- colnames(t_cells)[t_cells$seurat_clusters == "Myonuclei"]

sc_combined$subcluster[myonuclei_cells] <- "Myonuclei"

tcell_myonuclei_cells <- colnames(sc_combined)[
  sc_combined$subcluster == "Myonuclei" & sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "T cells"
]

sc_combined <- subset(sc_combined, cells = setdiff(colnames(sc_combined), tcell_myonuclei_cells))

rm(myonuclei_cells, tcell_myonuclei_cells)
```

```{r}
DotPlot(object = neutrophils, features = c(
  "mt-Co1", "mt-Co2", "mt-Co3", "Rpl12", ## Promyelocyte
  "Camp", "Cebpe", "Chil3", "Itgam", "Itgb2", "Ltf", "Ly6g", "Mmp8", "Ngp", "Retnlg", ## Myelocyte
  "Ccl6", "Cd33", "H2-D1", "Cxcr2", "Cxcr4", "Fos", "Sell", "Cebpb", "Dusp1", "Il1b",  "Junb" ## Metamyelocyte / Band neutrophil / Segmented neutrophil
  )) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("red", "white", "blue")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```


## Visualize subclusters

```{r}
DimPlot(neutrophils, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## Write new subcluster labels back into sc_combined

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$subcluster[names(neutrophils$seurat_clusters)] <- 
  as.character(neutrophils$seurat_clusters)
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(neutrophils, neutrophils_cluster_ids, neutrophils_cluster_labels, neutrophils_clusters)
```



# AT THE END CLEAN UP

## Remove cells with Erythrocytes or Epithelial cells subclusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined <- subset(sc_combined, cells = colnames(sc_combined)[!sc_combined$subcluster %in% c("Erythrocytes", "Epithelial cells")])
```


## For those without subclusters, make their seurat_clusters their subclusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$subcluster[is.na(sc_combined$subcluster)] <- as.character(sc_combined$seurat_clusters[is.na(sc_combined$subcluster)])
```


## Remove Adipocytes cluster (appears to be more Erythrocytes)

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined <- subset(sc_combined, cells = colnames(sc_combined)[!sc_combined$seurat_clusters %in% "Adipocytes"])
```


## Move subcluster column next to seurat_clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined@meta.data <- sc_combined@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::relocate(subcluster, .after = seurat_clusters)
```


## Order subclusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$subcluster <- factor(sc_combined$subcluster, levels = c("Quiescent SCs", "Activated SCs", "Cachectic SCs", "Pro-angiogenic SCs", "Committed myoblasts", "Differentiating myoblasts (2x)", "Differentiating myoblasts (2b/x)", "Differentiating myoblasts (2b)", "Type 1 myonuclei", "Type 2a/x myonuclei", "Type 2x myonuclei", "Type 2b/x myonuclei", "Type 2b myonuclei", "Capillary ECs", "Arterial ECs", "Venous ECs", "vSMCs", "Pericytes", "Stem FAPs", "Activated FAPs", "Pro-remodeling FAPs", "Pro-angiogenic FAPs", "Pro-adipogenic FAPs", "Immuno FAPs", "Tenm2+ FAPs", "Tenocytes", "Platelets", "Mast cells", "Dendritic cells", "Patrolling monocytes", "Inflammatory monocytes", "M1 macrophages", "M1/M2 macrophages", "M2 macrophages", "Promyelocytes", "Myelocytes", "Mature neutrophils", "Pro-B cells", "Naive B cells", "Immature B cells", "Regulatory B cells", "Plasma cells", "Naive T cells", "Cytotoxic T cells", "NK cells", "Neural/glial cells", "Schwann cells"))
```


## Split Monocytes/macrophages cluster

```{r}
sc_combined$seurat_clusters <- as.character(sc_combined$seurat_clusters)

# Monocytes
sc_combined$seurat_clusters[sc_combined$subcluster %in% c("Patrolling monocytes", "Inflammatory monocytes")] <- "Monocytes"

# Macrophages
sc_combined$seurat_clusters[sc_combined$subcluster %in% c("M1 macrophages", "M1/M2 macrophages", "M2 macrophages")] <- "Macrophages"

sc_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(sc_combined$seurat_clusters)
```


## Reorder clusters

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(sc_combined$seurat_clusters, levels = c("Satellite cells", "Myoblasts", "Myonuclei", "Endothelial cells", "vSMCs", "Pericytes", "FAPs", "Tenocytes", "Adipocytes", "Platelets", "Mast cells", "Dendritic cells", "Monocytes", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils", "B cells", "T cells", "NK cells", "Neural/glial cells", "Schwann cells"))
```

```{r}
  "Vwf", "Lrg1", "Ehd4", "Il6st", "Plvap", ## venous
  
  # vSMCs
  "Myl9", 
  
  # Pericytes
  "Pdgfrb",
  
  # FAPs

  "Dpp4", "Pi16", ## stem FAPs
  "Postn", "Timp1", ## activated FAPs
  "Mme", "Cxcl14", ## pro-remodeling FAPs
  "Cdh5", "Egfl7", ## pro-angiogenic FAPs
  "Gsn","Bgn", "Igfbp3", ## pro-adipogenic FAPs
  "Osmr", "Il6", "Ccl7", ## immuno FAPs
  "Tenm2", ## Tenm2+ FAPs
  
  # Tenocytes
  "Tnmd",

  # Mast cells
  "Cpa3", "Tpsb2",
  
  # Dendritic cells
  "Fscn1", "Flt3",

  "Ccr2", "Ly6c2", ## inflammatory Monocytes
  
  # Macrophages

  "C1qa", "Csf1r", "Fcgr3", ## anti-inflammatory Macrophage
  
  # Neutrophils

  "Camp", "Cebpe", "Chil3", "Itgb2", "Ltf", "Ly6g", "Mmp8", "Ngp", "Retnlg", "Itgam", ## Myelocyte
  "Cd33", "Cxcr4", "Dusp1", "Il1b", ## Metamyelocyte / Band neutrophil / Segmented neutrophil

  "Sell", "Cxcr5", "Bcl2", "Mzb1", ## Regulatory B cells
  "Jchain", "Xbp1", "Hsp90b1", ## Plasma cells
  
  # T cells

  "Ccr7", "Klf2", "Il7r", ## Naive (Cd44-) or memory
  "Ccl5", "Ctsw", "Klrd1", ## Cytotoxic T cells

)) +
```
